investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Zephyrent Health (clinic and patient management SaaS); Platform: on-premises data center DC-A, server range 10.65.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster zephyr-prod (kubeadm); External dependency: push-notifier calls a push notification service (push.notifly.net) protected by a circuit breaker; external synthetic probes monitor public dependencies; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
